title: Code Block
description: Code panel with tabs, line numbers, highlighted lines and a copy button.

a11y.motion: Nothing animates, so there is no reduced-motion difference; the copy icon swaps to a check mark instantly.
a11y.keyboard: The code area is focusable and scrolls with the arrow keys. With tabs, the tab list is one Tab stop: Left/Right arrows, Home and End switch files. The copy button is a native button.
a11y.screenReader: The code region is labelled with the file name, line numbers are aria-hidden, tabs use tablist/tab/tabpanel roles, and a status region announces "Copied to clipboard".
